messages:
Anya Patel: quick ping — opened PR #1228 to rename `request_id` -> `trace_id` and tidy a couple of lint nits in `kvcache`. Need one more approval before today's merge window (5pm PT). link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1228

Miguel Soto: taking a look now, ETA ~25m. is this visible to customers or internal only?

Anya Patel: internal only. added a compatibility shim that logs and maps old key for one release. also added a deprecation note in the CHANGELOG.

Samir Lee: quick nit — prefer `trace_id` (snake_case) everywhere, saw one instance `traceId` in `session.go` line ~42. also `make fmt` fails locally for me on that file.

Anya Patel: good catch, will push a follow-up commit to fix that casing and run `make fmt`.

ci-bot: build #4821 — status: running (checks: fmt, lint, unit-tests)

Miguel Soto: one question: does the shim add any perf overhead on hot path?

Anya Patel: shim is only on codepath when `request_id` header is present; it's a cheap map lookup + assign, not on hot decode/generate path. added comment in the code.

Samir Lee: another small thing — test name `TestRequestIDFallback` should be `TestTraceIDFallback` to match rename. can you update?

Anya Patel: pushed commit 7f3a2b1: fixed casing in session.go, renamed test, ran `make fmt` locally. PTAL.

ci-bot: build #4821 — status: failed (fmt step).

Anya Patel: hmm, CI still complaining about fmt — running `make fmt` again and checking diff.

Anya Patel: pushed commit 7f3a2b1-1: applied project's gofmt rules (tab width diff).

Miguel Soto: reviewing the latest commit. small suggestion inline about a comment wording.

Samir Lee: LGTM for functional changes. leaving a tiny nit on a comment that references the old header name.

Miguel Soto: approved. :+1:

ci-bot: build #4821 — status: success (all checks passed)

Anya Patel: thanks all — merging in ~5m during merge window. will cut a patch tag after merge.

Samir Lee: sweet, thanks for doing the followups. :slightly_smiling_face:

Anya Patel: merged and tagged v0.12.3 — release notes: rename request_id->trace_id, compatibility shim for one release, formatting fixes.

Miguel Soto: noted, will update internal ops runbook to use `trace_id`.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for staging.
